samuelbujoreanu: Benedikt "Brick" Samuelbujore signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F2 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
shawn_hohne: Ivo Hohne unpacked a frozen apple at R-F20. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
yee.zle: Valentin Zle signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Volunteer number 15. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Valentin Zle's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
The blanket exchange left Valentin Zle with a better blanket and a reputation for sharp dealing. The previous owner wants a rematch.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Valentin Zle ate two helpings anyway.

Nils Makinekivanc saw Valentin Zle freeze on the fire step at the Hanging Bridge. Nils said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough. Verdel Ridge has been won. Valentin Zle listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Rain all night. Valentin Zle bailed water out of S-F12 with a helmet until his hands stopped feeling anything.
